feeds.title: London On The Inside
feeds.description: Keeping Londoners in the know with news and reviews across food, music, fashion and lifestyle. Born from a love of unlocking hidden gems in a big city, London on the Inside connects people to local and global brands, discoveries and experiences.

feeds.title: Heart London Magazine
feeds.description: Heart London Magazine was created to help you get the most out of London and enjoy a slice of London Life. We bring you reviews on new products, tips on where to eat and where to drink in London, fun weekend trips away and exciting things for you to do in the beautiful city of London.

feeds.title: In the frow
feeds.description: This blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Fashion and Beauty. Victoria established Inthefrow in late 2012 during the completion of her Fashion PhD and career as a Fashion Marketing Lecturer at the University of Manchester. Within its first six months, Inthefrow won the Company Magazine Best Newcomer Blog Award, and the year later, the award for Best Established Blog.

feeds.title: London Unattached
feeds.description: London Lifestyle News for Metropolitans and beyond - Theatre, Opera, Ballet, Restaurant News and Review - London Unattached.

feeds.title: Mini Adventures
feeds.description: A travel and London lifestyle blog featuring food, fun and frolics in the big smoke & beyond. Mini Adventures provides quality, clean toys at very low prices. Local delivery is offered for a small fuel charge. Items will be offered for a period of 24 hours before being offered for sale again.

feeds.title: What Olivia Did
feeds.description: A fashion blog scattered with beauty, music, cooking and current trends, as well as the ramblings and adventures of a girl called Olivia.

feeds.title: Homegirl London
feeds.description: is a London Lifestyle Blog featuring interior design trends, home interiors, furniture makers, shopping in London, restaurants in London, places to visit in London and more so come and explore my London Lifestyle Blog.

feeds.title: The London Thing
feeds.description: A London lifestyle blog about cool London places, fashion, beauty and travel. However, the main aim of this blog is to inspire local residents, temporary visitors and anyone else who may want to come out and visit this gorgeous and exciting place.

feeds.title: Kentishtowner
feeds.description: The Kentishtowner website is dedicated to cultural affairs art, food, film, booze, fashion, history, music in this corner of central north London and beyond, we're not bound by boroughs or geography. We cover food & drink, lifestyle, the arts, travel and people.

feeds.title: Love London
feeds.description: Love London is run by JJ, Abby, Caren & Claire. We're on an adventure to discover the best bits of London (and the world!) and deliver them to you in bite size daily chunks. We love this city and the eclectic mix of restaurants, bars and styles that make it the amazing place it is. We talk about the great bits, and don't bitch about the bad.

feeds.title: Luisa-Christie

feeds.title: Emma Inks
feeds.description: An unintentionally alternative London lifestyle and travel blog. Inspired by city life, adventure, independence and the unusual.

feeds.description: A London lifestyle blog about cool London places, fashion, beauty and travel. However, the main aim of this blog is to inspire local residents, temporary visitors and anyone else who may want to come out and visit this gorgeous and exciting place.

feeds.description: Blogger Taryn's mission is to seek out the best money-saving tips and hacks. Read her latest articles sharing best practices for long-term money goals, such as saving for a house deposit, traveling, and investing, whilst also enjoying everything London has to offer.

feeds.title: SilverSpoon London

feeds.title: The Londoner

Her posts from around the globe are enough to make anyone jealous.

feeds.description: West London dweller in love with travel, fashion and culture who's often found pottering around Notting Hill or in a cinema. A wannabe interior designer, I love sausage dogs and a strong gin & tonic.

feeds.title: Illyana London
feeds.description: Illyana London is a fashion, lifestyle, health and travel blog written by Illyana Mputu. In this blog, Illyana expresses herself and talks about the issues other people avoid or are too ashamed to say. She was brought up in a very strict home with limits on what she could do, say, and think about. So if you are reading this, then you have come to the right place.

feeds.description: Diary of a Londoness is my personal and oftentimes quirky London blog. Walk with me through the streets of the metropolis and beyond, and experience what it's like to live in the world's culture capital. The London blog includes outings to the theatre, film, opera, as well as where to eat, drink, shop, and what to do with the little darlings. You can always find me in a London museum and I cover the latest exhibitions in London. I like to travel, so I sometimes pen my adventures abroad.
